ticket_price.note: 2026 three-day ticket incl. camping, sold in rising categories: Cat 1 JPY 23,000 to Cat 4 JPY 29,000; U-28 JPY 23,000. Advance only (ZAIKO), no gate sales. Extras: auto-camp JPY 35,000 to 40,000; parking JPY 6,000 or JPY 12,000; Tokyo bus JPY 18,000 return.

add_sources.note: @mindgames.labyrinth (6 Mar 2026): ticket categories, U-28 price, auto-camp and parking prices; advance sales only.
8 Oct 2026: The Labyrinth 2026 sold out, no tickets at the gate.
Oct 2025: biggest sound upgrade in over 10 years; Japan's Meta Audio specially ordered Funktion-One speakers, which Funktion-One UK built and shipped for the event.
Hinata Rental named the festival's official camping-gear rental service for 2026 (pickup and return at the campsite centre house).
Organiser: held at Naeba for 10 years until 2018, then moved to Hodaigi campsite (about 1,000 m altitude).
